content.text: Selling a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-how-creators-ghana-get-paid-3|The Complete]]s. But for millions of creators, the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-how-one-creator|COREMERCH guide to payment]] layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-solana-payments-digital-12|everything]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-first-principles-definitive-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Selling digital products like ebooks or templates without access to traditional payment platforms is a fundamental challenge for many creators. Solana offers a blockchain solution that enables seamless payments in various cryptocurrencies, providing a robust alternative for those locked out by conventional services. The system allows creators to retain more of their income, significantly reducing transaction fees compared to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% per sale. By utilizing Solana through services like NOWPayments, creators can keep more of their earnings and have full sovereignty over their sales processes.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind using Solana for digital sales is built on decentralized technology that allows for rapid transactions with low fees. At its core, a Solana payment integration utilizes smart contracts to facilitate direct cryptocurrency transactions between buyers and sellers. When a customer makes a purchase, the transaction is verified on-chain, and the digital product is automatically delivered through services like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This setup minimizes reliance on third-party platforms while ensuring secure and instant payment processing. Overall, the architecture enables a frictionless experience for both creators and customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are inaccessible or prohibitively expensive. Individuals selling products such as ebooks, courses, or templates can benefit significantly from this model, as it allows for full ownership of their sales and customer data. By implementing a sovereign commerce stack, creators are empowered to take control of their income streams without the overhead costs associated with traditional platforms. This approach is particularly beneficial for those in countries like Nigeria, Venezuela, and Zimbabwe, where market limitations often stifle entrepreneurial potential.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, compared to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this infrastructure include a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your store, a backend logic service such as Google Apps Script, and a secure storage solution through Supabase or Google Sheets. For payment processing, NOWPayments provides an easy way to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, with a minimal fee of just 0.5%. This combination not only reduces costs but also enhances scalability and reliability. Each component is designed to integrate seamlessly, creating a comprehensive framework that supports the sale and delivery of digital products.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your own sovereign digital commerce setup, begin by choosing your hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages. Next, set up Google Apps Script for managing backend logic and database storage. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions, ensuring you can accept payment in various cryptocurrencies. Load your products into your chosen storage solution and configure automated delivery systems. Finally, test the entire process to guarantee functionality before launching your store. This straightforward approach allows you to establish a profitable online presence without reliance on traditional payment processors.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a sovereign digital commerce stack built on Solana for payment processing. By integrating NOWPayments, you can accept cryptocurrency directly, which eliminates the need for conventional payment platforms that often impose high fees. This method not only allows you to retain more earnings but also gives you complete ownership of your sales infrastructure.
Keep full ownership of your digital sales infrastructure without platform dependency.

If you're looking to explore more about setting up a digital store without traditional payment systems, check out our Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, ensuring you can sell your products effectively. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
